selected_script.angle: A flat, wide push broom just bends across the tile surface and completely ignores the deep grout lines; switch to the V-shaped brush and professional formula that specifically target the narrow recessed grime.
selected_script.hook: Your standard floor broom is just bending over the dirt in your grout lines.

video_001_part_01.camera_angle: Realistic handheld phone-shot close-up to medium shot.
video_001_part_01.visual_action: 0-3s: Close-up of a wide standard push broom scrubbing a dirty tile floor. The wide bristles bend flat over the recessed grout line, completely failing to reach the dark grime inside. 3-6s: The white 32 oz Grout-eez bottle is shown pouring formula directly onto the line, then the bright blue V-shaped grout brush head drops perfectly into the narrow groove, immediately loosening the embedded dirt. 6-10s: Fast-cut showing a satisfying wipe revealing brightened, clean grout along a kitchen baseboard.
video_001_part_01.voiceover: If you're using a standard broom to scrub your tile, the bristles just bend right over the dirt in the grout lines. Switch to the Grout-eez kit—the professional formula breaks down the grime, and the stand-up V-brush drops right into the line to scrub it away effortlessly.

video_001_part_02.camera_angle: Realistic handheld phone-shot medium to wide shot.
video_001_part_02.visual_action: 0-4s: Fast-cut to a hallway tile floor. The user is comfortably standing up using an attached threaded pole to push the bright blue V-brush through a long grout line, lifting out dark grease. 4-8s: Fast-cut to a brightly lit foyer showing the final result—perfectly clean, restored white grout lines across the entire ceramic floor. 8-10s: The floor looks brand new, with text overlaid reading 'Make your space cleaner and cozier.'
video_001_part_02.voiceover: No more kneeling and no more skipped lines. It easily glides through hallways and totally restores your floors. Make your space cleaner and cozier, grab yours today.
